// Turns an ASF file made by ffmpeg into one dated only by WM/EncodingTime,
// as some encoders write it: the File Properties Object's creation date
// set to 0, and a WM/EncodingTime value (a FILETIME, QWORD type 4) added
// to the Extended Content Description Object. The header grows by the
// value's bytes; the Data Object after it and its packets, numbered
// rather than placed by offset, read as before.
//
// Usage: go run encodingtime.go <in.asf> <out.asf> <RFC 3339 time>
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

var (
	filePropsID = guid(0x8CABDCA1, 0xA947, 0x11CF, [8]byte{0x8E, 0xE4, 0x00, 0xC0, 0x0C, 0x20, 0x53, 0x65})
	extDescID   = guid(0xD2D0A440, 0xE307, 0x11D2, [8]byte{0x97, 0xF0, 0x00, 0xA0, 0xC9, 0x5E, 0xA8, 0x50})
)

func guid(a uint32, b, c uint16, d [8]byte) []byte {
	g := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(nil, a)
	g = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(g, b)
	g = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(g, c)
	return append(g, d[:]...)
}

func utf16z(s string) []byte {
	var b []byte
	for _, u := range utf16.Encode([]rune(s + "\x00")) {
		b = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(b, u)
	}
	return b
}

func main() {
	in, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	at, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, os.Args[3])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	filetime := uint64(at.Unix()+11644473600) * 1e7
	headerSize := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(in[16:])
	var objs []byte
	for p := 30; p < int(headerSize); {
		n := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(in[p+16:]))
		obj := bytes.Clone(in[p : p+n])
		switch {
		case bytes.Equal(obj[:16], filePropsID):
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(obj[24+24:], 0) // the creation date
		case bytes.Equal(obj[:16], extDescID):
			name := utf16z("WM/EncodingTime")
			d := binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(nil, uint16(len(name)))
			d = append(d, name...)
			d = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(d, 4) // QWORD
			d = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(d, 8)
			d = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(d, filetime)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(obj[24:], binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(obj[24:])+1)
			obj = append(obj, d...)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(obj[16:], uint64(len(obj)))
		}
		objs = append(objs, obj...)
		p += n
	}
	head := bytes.Clone(in[:30])
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(head[16:], uint64(30+len(objs)))
	out := append(append(head, objs...), in[headerSize:]...)
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
